comment: A drop-down on the top bar reads its value whole or goes to the overflow with the next control that does not fit. The stabiliser's mode was cut to "Aver…" at 1920 by 1080 in Full, and the preset as "P…" and the blend mode as "Normal (…" at 1280 by 1024 at a font size of 1.3 in Default. The bar is shot and dumped at both, with the overflow's list open at each so the controls that left read whole there.
